items.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
items.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

items.title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
items.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis are gaining ground and their advance could have dangerous consequences, writes the BBC's security correspondent.

items.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO
items.summary: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.

items.title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
items.summary: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.

items.title: When will we see Robert Pattinson as Bond in cinemas?
items.summary: Robert Pattinson has been announced as the next James Bond, becoming the seventh actor to take up the mantle of 007.

items.title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
items.summary: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.
